title: ValidationResult
description: Validate collects each fault into ValidationResult.Errors; FormatValidation renders them for a person. A fault holds a category and a message today, not yet the rule, path and allowed values the read model states.

title: fleet.Sweep
description: Not written yet: it will read the committed .stego/state.yaml in each named checkout, as the durable form of Service build applied, with no compiler and no network.

title: buildidentity.fromInfo
description: fromInfo builds the Record from debug.BuildInfo.

title: compiler.DriftResult
description: DetectDrift fills DriftResult with modified, deleted and changed inputs; FormatDrift renders it. A broken record shows as an error from LoadState, not as a field.

title: compiler.Plan
description: computePlan fills Plan with one action per file and the new record; FormatPlan renders it.

title: main.runRegistryInspect
description: runRegistryInspect resolves and loads the registry and prints one named component: its version, namespace, ports, slots and each setting's type and default. It covers one component, not yet an archetype's active component set, and it prints no allowed values, no optional flag and no mixin slots.

title: main.runRegistrySearch
description: runRegistrySearch resolves and loads the registry and lists every component with its version, provided and required ports and slots. It shows no stage and no namespace yet.

title: registry.ComponentConsumers
description: Not written yet: STEGO records no service's components in a place Supplying can read today. This names where the read model will be filled.
